name: Golden Paradise Residence Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Must open a Golden Paradise Foreign Currency Account (GPFCA) at a Central Bank-licensed local bank and deposit a minimum of US$200,000.
requirements.fix_path: Open a GPFCA and deposit at least US$200,000.

requirements.blocker_text: Police clearance from country of domicile (within 6 months) and medical clearance from an authorized local hospital covering malaria, filariasis, tuberculosis, and HIV/AIDS.

sources.title: Department of Immigration & Emigration, Sri Lanka (e-services portal) -- Golden Paradise Residence Visa: minimum US$200,000 deposit in a Golden Paradise Foreign Currency Account (GPFCA) at a Central Bank-licensed bank (up to half recoverable after year 1); police clearance (6 months) and medical clearance (malaria, filariasis, TB, HIV/AIDS) required; funds may be directed to government-approved investment projects, condominium purchases, real estate leasing, or Sri Lanka Development Bonds; 10-year validity, US$2,000 fee covering the full period; cancellable on written request with fund release

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Sri Lanka). Published on tier-1 sourcing (Department of Immigration & Emigration's own e-services portal). Genuinely current, active program -- see lk_investor_residence_rgs_legacy.json for the older Resident Guest Scheme program this appears to have effectively superseded for new applicants. The GPFCA structure (up to half the deposit recoverable after year one, remainder directable into government bonds/real estate/approved projects) resembles a 'golden visa' structure more closely comparable to European or Caribbean investor-residence programs than most other African/Asian countries built in this dataset.
